ABOUT_CONTRIBUTE_BODY.description: About window, Contribute tab: the text above the links to this game's contributing guide and its translation-fix form. Asks players not to send their changes to Pioneer, the game this one is a fork of, because Pioneer does not accept AI-assisted work. {game} is this game's name: keep it as it is and do not inflect it. Pioneer is a name: keep it as it is.
ABOUT_CONTRIBUTE_BODY.message: {game} este un fork al Pioneer realizat cu ajutorul IA. Vrei să schimbi sau să îmbunătățești ceva, ori să corectezi o traducere? Urmează linkurile de mai jos. Te rugăm să nu trimiți această muncă la Pioneer: proiectul nu acceptă contribuții realizate cu ajutorul IA.

ABOUT_DONATIONS_GO_TO_PIONEER.description: About window, Donate tab, shown under Pioneer's own request for donations and above its PayPal link. Says the money goes to Pioneer, the game this one is a fork of. {game} is this game's name: keep it as it is and do not inflect it (build the sentence so the name can stay as it is). Pioneer is a name: keep it as it is.
ABOUT_DONATIONS_GO_TO_PIONEER.message: Donațiile ajung la proiectul Pioneer, care a creat jocul original. {game} nu primește nimic din acești bani.

ABOUT_ORIGINAL_GAME.description: Heading in the About window's first tab, under the game's own homepage and bug tracker links. Below it is a link to the homepage of Pioneer, the game this one is a fork of. Pioneer is a name: keep it as it is.

FUEL_SCOOP_HYPERDRIVE_LEVEL.description: Comms log line shown in flight while the fuel scoop is filling the hyperdrive's own fuel tank, each time it gains another tenth of its capacity. The last line is sent when it is full. {quantity} is the tonnes of hydrogen now in it, with one decimal, for example 1.0.
FUEL_SCOOP_HYPERDRIVE_LEVEL.message: Colector combustibil activ pentru rezervorul hiperpropulsorului. Acum aveți {quantity} tone de hidrogen pentru salturi în hiperspațiu.

FUEL_SCOOP_TANK_LEVEL.description: Comms log line shown in flight while the fuel scoop is filling the ship's main propellant tank, each time the tank passes another 10%. {percent} is the tank level as a whole number, for example 70.
FUEL_SCOOP_TANK_LEVEL.message: Colector combustibil activ pentru rezervorul principal. Acum aveți {percent}% combustibil.

PLEASE_REPORT_THIS_ERROR.description: Shown on the error screen when a game screen fails. Asks the player to report the bug. {game} is the game's name and {issues_url} the web address of its issue tracker: keep both as they are and do not inflect {game} (build the sentence so the name can stay as it is). {path} is a folder.
